title: endless procedural backrooms in the browser
author: pablostanley
selftext:
The whole world comes from a seed: maze, furniture, landmarks, acoustics. Procedural geometry, no model files. VHS look is a WGSL post pipeline with a WebGL2 fallback

Built with Three.js (used Claude code which knows it really well) and vgpu for the WebGPU shaders. vgpu is lightweight and its docs are written for agents, so Claude could write and validate WGSL without me babysitting it

New maze on every visit. Poolrooms, food courts, a street, computers that load real websites over dial-up. oh... and something follows you

Play: [https://vackrooms.vercel.app](https://vackrooms.vercel.app)

Code: [https://github.com/pablostanley/vackrooms](https://github.com/pablostanley/vackrooms)
